title: Sword Shrine Guardian
description: A moody isometric 3D action game built with three.js. Take up a spirit blade at a mist-shrouded shrine: read enemy telegraphs, parry to open execution windows, dodge unblockable slams, unleash flying sword qi and a blade rain storm, and break the stone guardians' posture across two-phase boss fights. Elite affixes, random night events, falling meteors, fog merchants and a coin shop rewrite the rules wave by wave — forge your build, hold the shrine through rotating grounds in endless mode, and chase your best-wave record.
controls: WASD to move. J or left-click to attack (3-hit combo, third hit is heavy). K or right-click to parry — a successful parry opens an execution window; press attack to execute. Space to dodge with invincibility frames. L: flying sword qi. U: blade rain AoE. After each wave pick 1 of 3 upgrades and spend coins in the shop. Watch for random night events each wave. Clear the boss to unlock endless mode. Touch controls supported on mobile.
author: LightGame
